ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto prices slipped across the board, with Bitcoin down 1.7% to $82,869 and Ethereum falling 1.9% to $2,570, while the broader market shows modest weakness. The decline coincides with fresh negative headlines on oil price spikes and political tensions, as well as a surge in new token listings on Delta India.
